status: proposal (claude-a/progression-2, 26 Oct); every number is a placeholder until play-tests and Claude L's harness
name: Bramble
identity: older grassland ranger; left-handed archer: bow in the RIGHT hand, quiver over the LEFT shoulder, billhook at the RIGHT hip, folding buckler on the RIGHT forearm
home_region_note: see docs/vision/world-and-cast.md (26 Oct); it sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/bramble.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged; every node is a modifier over it

loadout_kind.label: bolt or arrow head
loadout_kind.rule: one loaded at a time, chosen outside fights; the base kind is free

nodes.name: Barbed heads
nodes.effect: Loads barbed bolts: they slow what they hit.

nodes.name: Fire heads
nodes.effect: Loads fire bolts: they set burn.

nodes.name: Fletcher
nodes.effect: The loaded kind's effect lasts 20 % longer.

nodes.name: Shard heads
nodes.effect: Loads shard bolts: they pierce one more foe and show a weak point.

nodes.name: Net heads
nodes.effect: Loads net bolts: they root a light foe; a tank is slowed instead.

nodes.name: Twin shot
nodes.effect: Every third shot looses two bolts side by side.

nodes.name: Three-bolt spread
nodes.effect: Twin shot becomes three bolts in a narrow fan.

nodes.name: Briar volley
nodes.effect: Briarshot's powered shots are three-bolt spreads.
nodes.note: changes a count or rule in Codex's kit or powered form; needs C60's OK (#149)

nodes.name: Briar snare
nodes.effect: Lowering the buckler just after a block drops a snare that roots the next foe on it.

nodes.name: Hook and loose
nodes.effect: A shot right after the billhook sweep fires point-blank with knockback.

weapon.line: Yew bow > Hedge crossbow > Repeating crossbow > Starfall repeater

art.description: the tier-1 drawing: a shallow recurve held in the right hand, quiver over the left shoulder

tiers.name: Hedge crossbow

art.description: a short ash-wood crossbow with a steel prod (bow arms) as wide as the shoulders, a walnut stock to the shoulder and a goat's-foot lever on the right side; bolts in the same quiver; slung across the back when the billhook is out
art.read_check: at 74 px and 1x the tier differs from the one before by at least 3 px of silhouette or one new 2 x 2 px colour cluster; sizes are relative to the tier-1 drawing

tiers.rig: parts + clips: new crossbow part; primary, powered_primary and guard (stow) redrawn as shoulder-and-loose; a lever reload clip (8 drawings)

mechanics.note: slower, harder-hitting bolts; damage per second held equal by gear level

tiers.name: Repeating crossbow

art.description: the crossbow gains a box magazine of 6 bolts on top of the stock and a cocking lever along the right side; the prod +2 px each end over tier 2
art.read_check: at 74 px and 1x the tier differs from the one before by at least 3 px of silhouette or one new 2 x 2 px colour cluster; sizes are relative to the tier-1 drawing

tiers.rig: parts: magazine and lever on the tier-2 crossbow; the lever pump is a 2-drawing overlay on the existing primary

tiers.name: Starfall repeater

art.description: moonwood stock and prod with crescent tips; the string drawn in starlight; the loaded bolt's head glows
art.read_check: at 74 px and 1x the tier differs from the one before by at least 3 px of silhouette or one new 2 x 2 px colour cluster; sizes are relative to the tier-1 drawing

tiers.rig: parts: ramp and tip swap on the tier-3 repeater

mechanics.named: Starlit: the loaded kind's effect is 25 % stronger

outfits.name: Autumn forester
outfits.description: russet mantle with a hood lying flat on the back below the quiver; oatmeal shirt

unlock.note: his folk quest (Claude K names it)

outfits.name: Sheepskin mantle
outfits.description: the same mantle with a 2 px fleece edge at the collar and hem, a knitted waistcoat under it

unlock.note: the Brackens mover's loom gives wool

outfits.name: Ranger's pine
outfits.description: deep pine-green mantle with a gold leaf clasp; dark trousers

accessories.name: Feathered cap
accessories.description: a small green felt cap on the curls with one pheasant feather (5 px) to the back

unlock.note: rare camp chest drop in the valley and woodland

accessories.name: Patched travelling cloak
accessories.description: a knee-length brown cloak with two square patches; it replaces the mantle and keeps the quiver over it

accessories.name: Oak-leaf scarf
accessories.description: a short knitted scarf with an oak-leaf pattern in two tones, one tail over the right shoulder

accessories.name: Acorn whistle
accessories.description: a carved acorn whistle on a cord at the belt, 3 x 4 px
